hit_dmg_u: %1$s leaps at you and strikes your %2$s!
miss_msg_u: %s tries to leap at you, but you dodge!
miss_msg_npc: %s tries to leap at <npcname>, but they dodge!
no_dmg_msg_u: %s leaps at you, but your armor protects you.
no_dmg_msg_npc: %s leaps at <npcname>, but their armor protects them.

hit_dmg_u: %1$s smashes your %2$s with devastating force, knocking you down!
hit_dmg_npc: %1$s smashes into <npcname> with devastating force, knocking them down!
miss_msg_u: %s tries to smash you, but you evade the devastating blow!
miss_msg_npc: %s tries to smash <npcname>, but they evade the devastating blow!
no_dmg_msg_u: %s smashes your %2$s, but your armor withstands the impact.
no_dmg_msg_npc: %s smashes <npcname>, but their armor withstands the impact.
